subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should OpenClaw continue owning a bundled, version-pinned Himalaya skill, or remove it from core and maintain it as an external ClawHub bundle?
rationale: The current docs are wrong, upstream v2 changed the command and composition model, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 is an active maintainer-owned removal decision, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent owner boundary.

options.title: Move to ClawHub
options.body: Remove the bundled copy and maintain version-specific Himalaya guidance in an externally owned skill bundle.

options.title: Maintain in core
options.body: Keep Himalaya bundled, name the supported upstream major version, and comprehensively rewrite all commands and composition guidance against that contract.

recommendation.title: Move to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Remove the bundled copy and maintain version-specific Himalaya guidance in an externally owned skill bundle.

likelyOwner.reason: The original addition, subsequent documentation maintenance, and prior issue review make this the strongest available routing owner for the ownership choice.
